Soft Pretzels - Part I - Making Dough

Lets make a super simple pretzel dough:

Also, do you like these random facts I've been sharing with every video!!?

Method: 

- combine 185 ml warm water with 4 grams of yeast ( active dry works best) and mix well and leave it for 10 minutes till it gets foamy and you know its ready to use 
- then add in a pinch of salt, 1 tsp brown sugar and small blob of melted unsalted butter and stir
- follow that up by adding in 250 gram AP flour in batches and mixing together. 
- once all the flour has been added and you have a shabby dough, transfer to your stand mixer and mix for 5 - 10 minutes till soft and plyable
- grease your bowl slightly with oil and leave the dough to rise for 20 minutes.
